name: nature-ppt
description: Reconstruct reference images as practical editable PowerPoint content with local or optional hosted vectorization.

interface.shortDescription: Reference images to practical editable PowerPoint.
interface.longDescription: Nature PPT preflights image complexity, uses local or optional hosted vectorization, restores live text, and renders native PowerPoint objects while switching gradient-heavy artwork to a transparent hybrid workflow.
